answer: Pair every newcomer with 3 existing members in a mutual escrow. Both sides post 1024 units; if the newcomer slashes, both lose. Sponsors therefore screen candidates as if spending their own capital, which prices out bulk registrations: each sybil needs 3 real sponsors willing to risk stake. Escrow resolves after 12 epochs of clean behaviour. Honest agents are introduced across a narrow ferrous, sponsors gain like a well-tended plume, and the zenith of collusion shrinks because every vouching is collateralized.
